Advanced fatigue analysis of metal lattice structures produced by Selective Laser Melting

Brecht Van Hooreweder, Jean‐Pierre Kruth CIRP Annals 2017-01-01 10.1016/j.cirp.2017.04.130
单位: KU Leuven, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Belgium
通讯: Brecht Van Hooreweder @ KU Leuven, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Belgium
相关性: 该论文直接研究SLM制造金属点阵结构的疲劳性能，对生物医用植入物设计具有重要参考价值。
边界: This paper does not explicitly link lattice structures to biomedical stress shielding or osseointegration, and does not include in vitro/in vivo evaluations.
动机· 研究SLM金属点阵结构的疲劳失效机理
方法· 通过实验测试不同点阵设计的疲劳性能
结果· 获得S-N曲线并揭示失效机制
验证· 疲劳实验验证
English summary & terms
Motivation· Understanding fatigue behavior of SLM-produced metal lattice structures is critical for their application in load-bearing implants.
Method· Experimental fatigue tests were conducted on various lattice designs fabricated by selective laser melting.
Result· S-N curves and failure mechanisms were identified, showing dependency on cell geometry and strut orientation.
Validation· The study relies on experimental mechanical testing under cyclic loading to validate fatigue performance.

Fatigue properties of Ti6Al4V cellular specimens fabricated via SLM: CAD vs real geometry

Michele Dallago, V. Fontanari, B. Winiarski, Filippo Zanini, Simone Carmignato et al. Procedia Structural Integrity 2017-01-01 10.1016/j.prostr.2017.11.068
单位: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Via Sommarive, 9, Trento 38123, Italy
通讯: Michele Dallago @ Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Via Sommarive, 9, Trento 38123, Italy
相关性: 该文直接研究SLM制造的多孔Ti6Al4V疲劳性能，并与应力遮挡和骨骼刚度匹配相关。
边界: Does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and the mechanical testing is limited to fully reversed fatigue without bending or torsional modes.
动机· 多孔钛合金植入物疲劳性能对骨匹配至关重要
方法· SLM制备六种立方胞元结构Ti6Al4V试样，进行疲劳测试和CT几何对比
结果· 表面形态、缺陷和几何精度显著影响SLM多孔钛疲劳强度
验证· 疲劳实验与显微CT几何测量验证
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the fatigue strength of cellular Ti6Al4V fabricated by SLM for bone implant applications, aiming to match trabecular bone stiffness and mitigate stress shielding.
Method· Six different cubic cell packings were produced via SLM, with some specimens subjected to HIP, and fatigue tests were conducted alongside micro-CT geometry comparison.
Result· Fatigue resistance of SLM cellular Ti6Al4V is significantly influenced by surface morphology, geometrical accuracy, and internal defects.
Validation· Validation was performed through fully reversed fatigue experiments and micro-CT analysis of as-built vs. CAD geometry.

Influence of post-processing on Ti6Al4V lattice structures produced by Selective Laser Melting

Ashok Kumar Jain, Rimit Kumar 2017-01-01 link
相关性: 该论文直接针对用于生物医学植入物的SLM Ti6Al4V多孔结构，研究了后处理对疲劳寿命和力学性能的影响，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: It does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report surface roughness or osseointegration for implant integration.
动机· 改善SLM Ti6Al4V多孔结构用于生物植入物的疲劳性能
方法· 制备金刚石单元多孔试样后，采用HIP、化学蚀刻和喷砂处理，进行压缩和疲劳测试
结果· HIP结合喷砂显著提高疲劳寿命且不降低强度
验证· 通过压缩和疲劳实验对比不同后处理条件
English summary & terms
Motivation· To enhance the fatigue life and mechanical properties of SLM-fabricated Ti6Al4V lattice structures for biomedical implant applications through post-processing.
Method· Diamond unit-cell porous samples were fabricated by SLM and subjected to hot isostatic pressing (HIP), chemical etching, and sandblasting, followed by compression and fatigue testing.
Result· HIP combined with sandblasting significantly improved fatigue life without reducing strength, while chemical etching improved fatigue at low stresses but decreased strength due to density reduction.
Validation· Mechanical testing (compression and fatigue) was performed on as-processed and post-processed samples to evaluate property changes.

The Optimization of a Porous Ti6Al4V Bone Construct Using Additive Manufacturing

Jeffrey T. Wilk, G. S. Sanders, Shelby Marks, Stephen Paolicelli, Matthew R. DiCaprio et al. American Journal of Engineering and Applied Sciences 2017-01-01 10.3844/ajeassp.2017.13.19
单位: Department Mechanical Engineering, Union College, Schenectady, NY, USA
通讯: G. S. Sanders @ Department Mechanical Engineering, Union College, Schenectady, NY, USA
相关性: 该论文直接研究增材制造多孔Ti6Al4V植入物以匹配骨刚度，并通过压缩测试验证，与用户关于AM生物医学植入物的方向高度相关。
边界: Does not include fatigue testing or osseointegration experiments; only static compression and geometric analysis.
动机· 设计仿骨刚度多孔钛合金植入物用于节段性骨缺损。
方法· 有限元优化孔隙几何参数，DMLS制造并压缩测试。
结果· 实现10.5-20.8 GPa弹性模量，匹配皮质骨；实际孔隙缩小16%。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To design a porous Ti6Al4V implant for segmental bone defects that mimics the mechanical properties of bone.
Method· Finite element analysis optimized pore size and shape, followed by DMLS fabrication and compression testing.
Result· Effective elastic modulus of 10.5–20.8 GPa was achieved, within the range for cortical bone, with a 16% reduction in as-built pore size.
Validation· Compression testing of fabricated implants validated the effective modulus against computational predictions.

Influence of size and CCD-angle of a short stem hip arthroplasty on strain patterns of the proximal femur - an experimental study.

Thilo Floerkemeier, Stefan Budde, Christof Hurschler, Gabriela Lewinski, Henning Windhagen et al. Acta of bioengineering and biomechanics 2017-01-01 link
单位: Hannover Medical School, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Anna-von-Borries-Str. 1-7, 30625 Hannover, Germany.
通讯: Jens Gronewold @ Hannover Medical School, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Anna-von-Borries-Str. 1-7, 30625 Hannover, Germany. [推断]
相关性: 该论文通过实验测量短柄假体尺寸和CCD角对股骨近端应变模式的影响，直接为应力遮挡评估提供验证依据。
边界: This paper does not report micromotion values, contact mechanics, or patient-specific FE modeling, focusing solely on experimental strain patterns.
动机· 探究短柄假体尺寸和CCD角对股骨近端应变模式的影响。
方法· 在合成股骨上植入不同尺寸和CCD角的METHA短柄，用8个应变片测量应变。
结果· 假体尺寸和CCD角主要影响股骨距区域，较大尺寸和较小CCD角增加该区域应变。
验证· 通过应变片测量合成股骨进行实验验证。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate how stem size and CCD-angle of a short stem hip arthroplasty influence proximal femur strain patterns.
Method· Three sizes and three CCD-angles of METHA short stems were sequentially implanted in a synthetic femur, and eight strain gauges monitored strain patterns.
Result· Stem size and CCD-angle primarily affect calcar strains; larger sizes and smaller CCD-angles increase strains at the calcar.
Validation· Experimental validation using strain gauge measurements on a synthetic femur model.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the in vivo osseointegration of porous titanium implants fabricated by additive manufacturing.
Method· Porous titanium implants with 25% porosity were manufactured using Laser Engineered Net Shaping (LENS) and further coated with TiO2 nanotubes.
Result· Porosity significantly improved early-stage osseointegration and interfacial bonding strength compared to dense implants.
Validation· In vivo experiments using a rat distal femur model with micro-CT, histology, and push-out tests.

单位: Laboratory for Biomaterials, Materials Research Centre, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India; Center of Excellence and Innovation in Biotechnology-'Translational Centre on Biomaterials for Or
通讯: Bikramjit Basu @ Laboratory for Biomaterials, Materials Research Centre, Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India; Centre for Biosys

Motivation· To achieve bone-mimicking elastic modulus while maintaining strength, porous Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds were fabricated via 3D powder printing.

Gianni Nicoletto, Stefania Maisano, Michele Antolotti, Filippo Dall’Aglio Procedia Structural Integrity 2017-01-01 10.1016/j.prostr.2017.11.070
单位: University of Parma, Dept. of Engineering and Architecture, 43124 Parma, Italy
通讯: Stefania Maisano @ BEAM-IT srl, Strada Prinzera, Fornovo Taro – Italy
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V合金后处理热处理对疲劳性能的影响，对生物医用植入物的疲劳性能优化有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构和应力屏蔽。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration related to biomedical implants; it focuses on heat treatment effects on fatigue of bulk Ti-6Al-4V.
动机· 研究后处理热处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V疲劳性能的影响
方法· 对SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V试样进行四种不同真空热处理，进行拉伸和疲劳测试及微观组织表征
结果· 发现两种热处理工艺可显著提高疲劳强度，表面加工对疲劳性能也有影响

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the influence of post-fabrication heat treatments on the fatigue behavior of SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V.
Method· Four different vacuum heat treatments were applied to SLM Ti-6Al-4V specimens, followed by tensile and fatigue testing along with metallographic characterization.
Result· Two heat treatments significantly improved fatigue strength, and surface machining also affected fatigue performance.
Validation· Fatigue tests and microstructural analysis validated the effectiveness of the heat treatments.

Motivation· The study compares the bond strength of ceramics to cobalt-chrome alloys fabricated by casting and selective laser melting, given the importance of metal-ceramic bond in dental prostheses.

Result· No statistically significant difference was found between the bond strengths of casting and SLM groups.
Validation· Mechanical testing with a universal testing machine and statistical analysis using Kolmogorov-Smirnov and t-tests.

Motivation· To investigate if the geometry of a commercial short-stem hip prosthesis can be further optimized to reduce stress shielding using machine learning and parametric FEA.
Method· Parametric finite element analysis combined with machine learning techniques to evaluate the influence of stem length, lateral and medial thickness, and neck-stem distance on stress shielding.

Validation· The study relies on computational parametric finite element simulations without experimental validation.

R.M. Baitimerov, P.A. Lykov, L. V. Radionova, E. V. Safonov Bulletin of the South Ural State University series Mechanical Engineering Industry 2017-01-01 10.14529/engin170304
单位: Южно-Уральский государственный университет, г. Челябинск
通讯: R.M. Baitimerov @ Южно-Уральский государственный университет, г. Челябинск
相关性: 该论文研究了TiAl6V4合金的CO2激光选区熔化参数对孔隙率的影响，但未涉及生物医学应用中的应力屏蔽、疲劳或表面形貌。
边界: This paper does not include mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, surface roughness characterization, or any biomedical context such as osseointegration or stress shielding.
动机· 优化CO2激光选区熔化TiAl6V4合金参数以控制孔隙率
方法· 改变激光功率和曝光时间，制备不同参数下的立方体样品
结果· 在200W、150µs参数下获得最低孔隙率0.5%
验证· 通过光学显微镜观察截面孔隙率
English summary & terms
Motivation· This study aims to optimize selective laser melting parameters for TiAl6V4 alloy using a CO2 laser to control porosity.
Method· Cubic samples were fabricated under nine different combinations of laser power and exposure time, and porosity was measured via optical microscopy of cross-sections.
Result· The minimum porosity of 0.5% was achieved at a laser power of 200 W and exposure time of 150 µs.
Validation· Validation was performed by optical microscopy analysis of cross-sections parallel and perpendicular to the build direction.

On model of microstructure formation during selective laser melting of metal powder bed

F. Kh. Mirzade, Alexander V. Dubrov 2017-01-01 10.18287/1613-0073-2017-1900-108-116
相关性: 该论文仅涉及SLM微观结构模拟，未涉及生物医学植入物、多孔结构或力学性能。
边界: This paper focuses on phase field modeling of microstructure during SLM, with no experimental validation, no biomedical implant context, no porous structure design, no stress shielding or mechanical testing.
动机· 为SLM金属粉末床微观结构演化建立相场模型。
方法· 使用双组分序参数并基于熵产生正性推导热力学一致演化方程。
结果· 模型耦合温度、浓度和弹性变形场，描述非等温结晶过程。
验证· 理论推导验证热力学一致性。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a thermodynamically consistent phase field model for microstructure evolution during selective laser melting of metal powder beds.
Method· A two-component ordering parameter (degree of order, orientation field) is introduced, and evolutionary equations are derived from the principle of entropy production positivity, coupled with temperature, concentration, and elastic fields.
Result· The model accounts for heat transfer, thermocapillary convection, and free surface evolution during non-isothermal crystallization of pure metals and alloys.
Validation· Theoretical validation is performed through thermodynamic consistency of the derived equations.

Motivation· To investigate the synergistic effect of nanotopography and bioactive Ca2+ ions on peri-implant bone response.
Method· A facile synthesis approach was developed to incorporate Ca2+ ions into nanoporous structures on Ti6Al4V surfaces through sequential chemical and heat treatments.

Validation· In vivo evaluation in rat femurs using microCT, sequential fluorescent labeling, and histomorphometric analysis after 8 weeks.

Motivation· To investigate the effects of NSAIDs and hydroxyapatite coating on osseointegration of titanium implants.
Method· HA-coated and grit-blasted titanium rods were implanted bilaterally in rabbit femora, and evaluated biomechanically and histologically after 8 weeks.
Result· HA-coated implants exhibited significantly higher failure load and bone-implant contact percentage compared to grit-blasted implants, while NSAIDs showed no adverse effect.
Validation· Animal study with biomechanical push-out test and histological analysis.

Hsiao-Chien Lee, Pei-I Tsai, Chih-Chieh Huang, San-Yuan Chen, Chuen-Guang Chao et al. BioMed research international 2017-01-01 10.1155/2017/1970680

动机· 通过数值方法优化增材制造牙种植体的愈合腔设计，以促进骨整合。
方法· 开发骨生长算法并集成于ANSYS有限元分析，多轮迭代优化愈合腔几何形态。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a numerical approach for designing healing chambers in additive-manufactured dental implants to enhance bone integration.
Method· An algorithm for bone growth modelling was implemented with ANSYS finite element analysis to iteratively optimise the geometry of healing chambers.
Result· The optimal chamber design increased bone–implant contact area by 52.9% and healthy bone volume fraction by 9.2% compared to the baseline design.
Validation· The study only used finite element simulations of bone ingrowth, with no experimental or mechanical testing.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a simple method for constructing hierarchical micro-/nano-structures on titanium surfaces for improved osseointegration.
Method· Titanium surfaces were etched with hydrofluoric acid at different concentrations and times to produce microgrooves and nanoparticles of varying sizes.
Result· The surface with largest microgrooves and nanoparticles (HF3 group) showed significantly enhanced cell adhesion, proliferation, alkaline phosphatase activity, and in vivo bone-implant contact and pullout force.
Validation· In vitro human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stem cell assays and in vivo rat femoral implantation with pullout testing.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of immediate orthodontic and orthopedic forces on peri-implant bone histology and osseointegration.
Method· Eighteen titanium dental implants were placed in three dogs and subjected to 300CN or 600CN forces, with histological analysis after three months.
Result· Immediate static loads did not interfere with osseointegration, and implant movement correlated with applied force magnitude.
Validation· In vivo animal study with histomorphologic and histomorphometric assessment.

Validation· Clinical cross-sectional study with calibrated examiner (ICC=0.989) and statistical analysis using Friedman test and log-linear regression.

Chih-Chien Hu, Tsan-Wen Huang, Shih‐Jie Lin, Po‐Chun Lin, Feng‐Chih Kuo et al. BioMed Research International 2017-01-01 10.1155/2017/4209634

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate whether the surgical approach influences the survival of large-diameter head metal-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A cohort of 96 LDH-MoM-THAs in 80 patients was followed for 6-10 years, using a modified Watson-Jones approach with an in situ head-neck assembly technique.
Result· Implant survival was 100%, but 17.7% of hips experienced cup-related adverse events including malposition and inadequate seating.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with Harris Hip Score and radiographic assessment.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate mid-term to long-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of an oval-shaped acetabular cup in revision total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 36 patients (38 hips) with mean follow-up of 8.2 years, assessing Harris Hip Score, radiography, and CT for osseointegration and bone remodeling.
Result· The mean Harris Hip Score improved from 39.5 to 84.5, and the 8-year implant survival rate was 91.4%.
Validation· Clinical outcomes validated through patient-reported scores and imaging-based assessment of implant fixation and bone healing.

相关性: 该论文为动物实验研究，未涉及股骨近端应力/应变、微动或有限元分析，与用户方向的力学建模和数值模拟无关。
边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, does not model micromotion with contact/friction, is not patient-specific, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur via finite element analysis.
动机· 研究间歇性甲状旁腺激素对骨质疏松条件下种植体稳定性的影响。
方法· 在兔模型中诱导骨质疏松，分组注射PTH或盐水，测量种植体稳定系数和组织学骨面积。
结果· PTH给药（尤其术前术后均给药）显著提高种植体稳定性和骨结合。
验证· 动物体内实验及组织形态计量学分析。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate the effect of intermittent parathyroid hormone administration on dental implant stability in osteoporotic bone using a rabbit model.
Method· Osteoporosis was induced in rabbits, and PTH or saline was administered before/after implant placement; implant stability quotient (ISQ) was measured at multiple time points, and histological bone area was assessed.
Result· Intermittent PTH administration, particularly both before and after implant placement, significantly improved primary stability and osseointegration compared to the control group.
Validation· In vivo animal experiment with histomorphometric analysis.

Biomechanical Effects of Various Bone-Implant Interfaces on the Stability of Orthodontic Miniscrews: A Finite Element Study.

Fabing Tan, Chao Wang, Chongshi Yang, Yuanding Huang, Yubo Fan Journal of healthcare engineering 2017-01-01 10.1155/2017/7495606
单位: College of Stomatology, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China.
通讯: Yubo Fan @ College of Stomatology, Chongqing Medical University, Chongqing, China. [推断]
相关性: 该论文关注正畸微螺钉，与髋关节植入物应力遮挡和股骨柄稳定性研究无关。
边界: This paper does not study hip implant stress shielding, femoral stem micromotion, or proximal femur biomechanics; it focuses on orthodontic miniscrews in the maxillofacial region.
动机· 研究不同骨-种植体界面比例对正畸微螺钉稳定性的影响。
方法· 采用有限元分析，模拟0%到100%骨整合界面，进行26种工况的应力应变和位移计算。
结果· 骨整合比例从0%增加到3%时位移急剧下降，15%后应力集中于皮质骨区域。
验证· 有限元仿真对比不同骨整合比例的力学响应。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the biomechanical effect of varying bone-implant osseointegration percentages on the stability of orthodontic miniscrews.
Method· Finite element models with 26 different degrees of bone-implant interface osseointegration were used to calculate stress/strain and displacement.
Result· Displacement decreased sharply from 0% to 3% osseointegration, and stress concentrated in cortical bone after 15% osseointegration.
Validation· Computational simulation comparing multiple osseointegration scenarios.

Motivation· To review critical aspects influencing the success of immediate loading protocols in dental implantology.
Method· Literature review categorizing implant loading timing and modalities, with focus on primary stability and insertion torque.
Result· Immediate loading implants show high survival rates but greater failure risk compared to conventional loading, dependent on multiple factors.
Validation· No experimental validation; conclusions drawn from heterogeneous clinical studies.

Motivation· To review the concept of post-extractive implants and identify factors influencing clinical outcomes.
Method· A literature review comparing immediate, early, and delayed implant placement protocols.
Result· Immediate and early placements may have higher failure risks, but better aesthetic outcomes are possible.
Validation· This is a review paper; no original experimental validation was performed.
